[[File:Dwarf_Spider_Dwarf.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A DSD1 dwarf spider droid flanked by a pair of OG-9 homing spider droids during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].]]
{{Quote|I hate spiders! Crush them like the bugs they are!|[[X1]], on the OG-9 homing spider droid|<ref name="Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''spider droid family''' was a line of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]<ref name="The Droids of Episode III">{{InsiderCite|81|The Droids of Episode III: It's a Junkyard Smackdown!}}</ref> manufactured by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and its subsidiary, [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]],<ref name="Techno Union">{{DB|organization|technounion|Techno Union}}</ref> that included the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]], [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]], and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]].<ref name="The Droids of Episode III" />
